Review for Rachel Cox – Langley Health Centre

I would like to express my sincere thanks and appreciation for the exceptional care I received from Rachel Cox at Langley Health Centre.

I initially contacted the practice due to pain in my flanks. Although I had experienced a fall some time previously, the pain felt similar to kidney-related discomfort I had experienced in the past, which understandably caused concern. Rachel listened carefully and took my worries seriously. She promptly arranged for a urine sample to be submitted and, when I mentioned ongoing bowel issues, also organised a stool sample to ensure nothing was overlooked.

Rachel then invited me in for a face-to-face appointment to assess whether my symptoms were related to my kidneys. She carried out a very thorough examination, explained things clearly, and was both reassuring and professional throughout. Her manner was calm, kind, and genuinely caring, which immediately put me at ease.

I was extremely impressed not only by Rachel’s clinical competence but also by her warmth and compassion. She is a truly lovely person and clearly an asset to the Langley Health Centre team. I do not visit the doctors often, but this experience has genuinely restored my faith in primary care. It was clear that Rachel truly cares about her patients and is committed to being thorough and attentive.

Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to Rachel, and my appreciation to Langley Health Centre for having such a dedicated and professional clinician. She is someone who makes a real difference, and I felt compelled to write this review to ensure she knows how valued she
